bear.text: EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% in Q1 FY27, down 170 basis points from 12.9% in the prior year quarter, primarily due to rising copper costs.
Receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year, a trend the CFO attributes to slower payments from two large state utility customers.
The company disclosed in September 2026 that it received a GST demand order for ₹46.3 crore, including interest and penalties, related to input tax credits for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22.

bull.text: Revenue from operations grew 18.0% year-on-year to ₹1,248 crore in Q1 FY27, driven by demand from power transmission and data-centre projects.
The order book stood at ₹3,900 crore as of 30 June 2026, an increase from ₹3,150 crore a year earlier, indicating strong future demand visibility.
Management maintains its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15 to 17 percent, suggesting confidence in sustained demand.
The new Bharuch plant, which adds about 30% to cable capacity, is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27, with management noting it will contribute from the second half.

open_questions.text: How will the one-to-two quarter lag in price-variation clauses affect margins in the next two quarters as copper costs remain elevated?
What is the likelihood of the company successfully appealing the ₹46.3 crore GST demand, and could an adverse outcome contradict the management's view of no material impact?
Will the slower payments from the two large state utility customers continue to pressure working capital, or has the monitoring process identified any signs of default?

snapshot.text: Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires, and conductors listed on the NSE under the ticker SRVCABLE.
For Q1 FY27, the company reported revenue of ₹1,248 crore and profit after tax of ₹82 crore, representing year-on-year growth of 18.0% and 5.9% respectively.
As of June 2026, promoters held 58.2% of the company, with 4.1% of that holding pledged, a significant decrease from 11.5% pledged in June 2025.
Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, up from 16% in the same quarter of the previous year.
